name: ibh-monorepo
description: ibh — an application-agnostic, in-browser agent harness. Drop-in on any site: acts on behalf of the signed-in user through an explicit, enforced capability manifest.

scripts.publish:dry: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @gametorch/ibh --filter @gametorch/ibh-react --filter @gametorch/ibh-vue --filter @gametorch/ibh-angular --filter @gametorch/ibh-svelte --filter @gametorch/ibh-solid exec npm pack --dry-run
scripts.publish:all: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm -r publish --access public --provenance
scripts.publish:all:provenance: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm -r publish --access public --provenance
scripts.publish:all:noprovenance: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm -r publish --access public
